_: Visual Pinball tables of the modern games PAD reads, by platform (PAD-943, surveyed 2026-11-02). Stern SAM and the
WPC remakes are not here: Visual PinMAME runs those games from their own ROM sets already (David: no reinventing
the wheel; Spike 1, Spike 2 and the other modern machines are the point).
PAD ships no table: each entry says where its author put it. `kind`: tribute = a scripted original with its own
VBScript rules (what vpxshadow.py bridges to the real game); mashup = an older game's ROM under the playfield
(what a .vpxmap.json patcher bridges). `faithful`: the table is the machine's own layout, so the real game's
switches and inserts fit it; a themed tribute of the film or band is not. `map`: the kit's map for it, when there
is one. VPUniverse and VPForums downloads take a free account.
`needs`: what playing the real game would take on this PC however a bridge is built (JJP: the machine's own security key).
`no_game`: why no table can ever play that title's real game on this PC, whatever map is written (PAD-952).

jjp.needs: The real game runs only with the machine's own security key: the purple USB dongle (Sentinel HL), one per title, plugged into this PC. Without it the game stops at 'Sentinel key not found (H0007)', so no table could ever play the real game without the key.
